title: Image previews under messages
spec: REQUIREMENTS 2.4 image previews (owner decision 2026-11-26: the image crate's pure-Rust PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP decoders). previewable(chip): a .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp name, 1 byte to MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES (8 MiB), not the not-archived id. The window asks once per file (Command::Preview { file, size }) for the open room's previewable attachments; the worker fetches the bytes into memory (SignedInSession::download_bytes, capped) and emits Event::Preview (Update::Preview), empty on failure. decode_preview decodes within limits (8192 px a side, 256 MiB while decoding) and scales to at most 320 px wide; the window turns it into a texture and draws it above the file chip; bytes that do not decode leave the chip and are never asked for again.
